svg.title: P control of the heater with two delivery delays
svg.desc: With a 1 second delay the water settles at 35.067 degrees Celsius within 6 seconds. With an 8 second delay it oscillates once every 22.6 seconds, each swing 1.44 times the one before, from 0.095 to 0.570 degrees above the balance.
svg.text: P control of the heater with a 1 s and an 8 s delivery delay
Control Studio recording of this project · Kp = 10 %/°C · setpoint 35 → 35.1 °C · numbers answer the predictions
